## Checklist

- [ ] The current canonical owner path in `STRUCTURE.md` is respected.
- [ ] Hypotheses are clearly separated from verified findings.
- [ ] Provenance and supporting evidence are recorded where practical.
- [ ] Real regional/language/revision differences are preserved.
- [ ] Semantic coordinates match Tsubaki where shared.
- [ ] No complete playable ROM image files are included.
- [ ] Documentation/manifests were updated when identity, provenance, or verification state changed.
